targets.data: the 2023 pre-trial's destructive samples (DestructiveHarvest.xlsx, All Data) on 18 and 29 September and 9 November 2023, per light zone and EC treatment, means per plant
targets.exclusion: an organ dried heavier than it weighed fresh is no target, nor is its plant's dry weight above ground

objective: decision 0076: the sum over the targets of ln((predicted + c) / (measured + c))², c half the smallest mean above zero of each quantity
drivers: drivers.py's 2023 series, one per light zone, with the sha256 drivers.json gives
initial_state: the 2023 transplants per plant (harness.transplants), scaled to the density at transplanting

method.scaling: each parameter mapped linearly from its bounds to [0, 1]
method.start: the published values, each held within its bounds

fixed: every other parameter at its published value; ρ is the density in force (harness)

parameters.name: n_ff
parameters.why: The nodes at which the first fruit sets, the screen's largest change (60.7 of 89.5). The published 22 nodes are an indeterminate crop's: the pre-trial's dwarf crop had fruit set by 29 September, 25 days after transplanting, where the published run sets none. Bounded below by the transplants' five leaves.

parameters.name: delta
parameters.why: The leaf area added with each node, at most (m² node⁻¹). The pre-trial's leaf area index was 1.28 to 2.54, the published run's 1.5 to 4.0, at its cap; a dwarf plant's leaves are smaller than the indeterminate crop's the value is for. Screen: 24.5.

parameters.name: qe
parameters.why: The leaves' quantum efficiency, the light the crop turns into growth. Screen: 33.4. E, the conversion of CH₂O to dry weight, moves the objective the same way (34.6); one of the two is calibrated, the leaves' rather than the biochemical conversion.

parameters.name: alpha_f
parameters.why: The share of net growth to the fruit, at most. Weak in the screen (6.0) only because the published run sets no fruit until late; once fruit sets earlier it decides the fruit's dry weight, 67 % of the pre-trial's dry weight above ground by 9 November.

not_chosen: n_max (58.8: both steps worsen it, and without the node counts among the targets it trades off against n_ff), e (with qe), n_b, p_1, lai_max, sl_n1 (24.8 to 30.0).
